opinion item (criticism of PM VIKAS merger)

pyq_bad.why: garbled; wrong topic: Panchayati Raj committees

patterns: APPSC asks direct article recall: Art. 30 = minorities' educational institutions, Art. 350B = Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities.

APPSC statement items: 'minority rights are absolute' is the untrue one; minority status decided by State demography; NCM set up under 1992 Act and recommends safeguards (Ministry of Welfare notifying five is the wrong statement).
Recent APPSC G2 tested Sachar's Ajlaf (like Hindu OBCs) and scheme-purpose items (Nai Roshni = minority women's leadership; PM Vishwakarma not for fishermen).
Other PSCs test Jains as sixth minority (2014), religious + linguistic minorities only, 29(2) grounds.
App adds heavy Waqf 2025 / SC interim order, DNT, OBC scholarship and credit-corporation detail well beyond PYQ depth.
